title: Closing a sprint leaves its runner's worktree, its orch branch and the empty worker branches in the clone the runner ran in, because the close cleanup names only work/<id> and worktree-agent-* branches with a KB-Work trailer
goal: the cleanup step of /kb-sprint close (and backlog.md where it repeats it) also removes the closed sprint's runner worktree .claude/worktrees/runner-SP-* with its orch/SP-* branch and _cache/autopilot/SP-*, and a worktree-agent-* branch with no commits of its own, never with --force and never another sprint's; a check reads the skill and fails when a runner worktree of a closed sprint is not named; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3): after the throwaway sprint closed, the runner clone still held the runner worktree, the orch branch, a detached agent-* worktree of a landed item and two empty worktree-agent-* branches, and none of them is matched by the skill's rule

run: import sys; t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read(); i=t.index('**Clean up**'); sys.exit(0 if 'runner-' in t[i:] else 1)

repro_reason: the cleanup is a list of steps the orchestrating agent follows in the skill, not a command: no tool run shows it, so the repro reads the skill's step for the runner worktree
